'''Fondo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] thug who worked for the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]-based Rodian [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Torani Kulda]] alongside two other thugs. Fondo and the others were eventually brought by Kulda to participate in a potentially deadly competition known as a [[Granee Noopa]].

==Biography==
[[File:WheetaPalace-LoNH.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Fondo attended a Granee Noopa at Wheeta Palace.]]
Fondo was, along with [[Tyss]] and [[Plaado]], one of three thugs in the service of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]-based [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Torani Kulda]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Fondo and the others were brought by Kulda to a [[Granee Noopa]] in [[Wheeta Palace/Legends|Wheeta Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The event was a potentially deadly competition between three separate groups, including Kulda's and one led by the disgraced [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Shalo Sherin]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Fondo was present in the palace's foyer when the attendees were introduced to one another and allowed to assess each other. After the introductions, the attendees were taken to a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] and served drinks, half of which were [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]]. The three Hutt representatives at the Granee Noopa&mdash;known as [[boddah]]s&mdash;were each given the identities of one-third of the poisoned drinks, information that the attending groups could choose whether or not to share with one another. Each of the attendees was required to take a drink, which they then used to toast their rivals.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Personality and traits==
Fondo was a member of the<ref name="LoNH" /> [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Fondo's appearance was extremely similar to the other thugs in Kulda's employ, and all three were extremely loyal to her.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Equipment==
Fondo and the other thugs in Kulda's employ all wore a heavy [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] and used a low-slung [[Holster/Legends|holster]] to store weapons, including a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]], the blade of which Fondo touched in a threatening manner whenever possible. Fondo also possessed a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lordsofnalhutta.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Fondo was created for ''Lords of Nal Hutta''.]]
Fondo was introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]. In the book, Fondo is described as a non-player character in the "Rubbing Slimy Elbows" modular encounter.<ref name="LoNH" />

''Lords of Nal Hutta'' suggests that during certain parts of the encounter the game-master player should cinematically describe those actions&mdash;and their consequences&mdash;of non-player characters that do not directly affect the player characters, as opposed to rolling dice to individually determine whether each of them manages to overcome the challenges of the competition. During the third stage of the encounter's Granee Noopa event, known as the [[Dinner]], the number of opponents faced by the participants depends on the number of the latter, which may include Fondo if the character has survived both the toasting scene and the second stage, the [[Dance]].<ref name="LoNH" />
